Summary: The creation mandate, restated to Noah after the flood: humanity is to multiply and fill the earth.
Commandment: Be fruitful, multiply, and fill the earth.
Application: Given first in Eden and repeated as the first word of the post-flood world, this is a standing mandate, not a moment's task. The Genesis 1 and Genesis 9 utterances are one command restated, not two commands.
Purpose: To fill the earth with image-bearers who carry God's blessing outward; Genesis 1:28 joins it to dominion, and Genesis 9:1-7 restates it as the foundation of the renewed world.
